methodology: One fresh SGB process per graph, -tf mode, one timed run; wall time includes process startup. Reference independently enumerates all 4-vertex subsets using an adjacency matrix. Square components are formed by shared-diagonal union-find. Disconnected original graphs omit square metrics in SGB; only n/legacy CFS can then be compared. Intended CFS allows a complete join factor, with square support kept literal; its mismatch is reported separately from legacy-reference agreement. C100 is a known undefined-behavior probe, not evidence the empty-square path is safe.
